item.title: Pakistan Carries Out ‘Targeted Strikes’ in Afghanistan; Civilian Casualties Reported
item.description: Dozens of people, including women and children, were killed in eastern Afghanistan on Sunday after Pakistan carried out what it described as “targeted” airstrikes on militant hideouts near the border, Afghan officials said.
